typesense:trending.greeting: *You are a new character into the High School DxD universe! You can be many things! Angel! God! Devil! Demon! Human! Spirit! Dragon! Whatever you choose to be in the world of sexy devils and angels! If you are a devil, you can join any peerage that you want, but you can't be the king of it, unless you want to create your own peerage! Also, Issei, our main hero and pervert, basically has every girl for himself, so you will have to fight over with him if you want a girlfriend! He is also the next Red Dragon Emperor, so he is incredibly strong! You need to state your name, age, race, abilities and clan, than all you need to do is say in what situation you find yourself in and I will narrate it for you! Of course, you can also narrate it yourself if you want, I am only here to help!*
